name: Lemon-Pepper Baked Salmon with Asparagus and Roasted Baby Potatoes
description: Salmon baked just to flaking with lemon and cracked pepper, with asparagus and crisp-skinned baby potatoes off the same oven.
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets (about 6 oz each), skin on
1 lb asparagus, woody ends snapped off
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the halved potatoes with 2 Tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp salt, and pepper, and spread cut-side down on a sheet pan.
Roast the potatoes 25 minutes while you prep everything else.
Pat the salmon dry and set it on a parchment-lined pan. Brush with the melted butter mixed with the garlic, lemon zest, and half the lemon juice.
Season the fillets with the remaining salt and the cracked pepper, and lay a lemon slice on each.
Toss the asparagus with the last 2 Tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper.
At the 25-minute mark, flip the potatoes, add the asparagus to their pan, and slide the salmon in on a second rack.
Bake 12–14 minutes, until the salmon flakes at the thickest part and reads 125–130°F for medium.
Finish everything with the rest of the lemon juice and the parsley.
tips: Salmon goes from perfect to dry in about two minutes. Start checking at 11 and pull it when the center still looks slightly translucent.
Cut-side down on the potatoes, undisturbed for the first 25 minutes, is what gets the crust.
Thin asparagus needs 10 minutes, thick spears 15. Sort by thickness rather than by the clock.
